outline.heading: What a plan is made of

points.text: The plan of the first step gathers everything you did in the course: the form of the meeting (module 04); the date and how many people; whom to invite and why (module 04); which steps of the method go into the meeting (module 02); how to tell current clients and who stays one to one (module 04); the sign that the step worked.

outline.heading: The sign that the step worked

points.text: The sign is named before the meeting, not after.
The format ladder page has a “My map” block.
The practitioner's plan: “Mini-group: breath and back”.
The first step is put into the week, even if one session has to move for it, not left waiting for room to appear.

points: Your plan for the first step gathers everything you did in the course.
It includes the meeting form, date, how many people, and whom to invite and why from module 04.
The plan also includes method steps from module 02 and how to tell current clients and who stays one to one from module 04.
It also shows the sign that the step worked.
You name the sign before the meeting instead of after it.
You put the first step into your week instead of waiting for room to appear.
This happens even if you have to move one session for it.
